authorship_note: Project source was developed with AI assistance and includes adapted or inherited framework/runtime helpers. The inventory identifies submitted source; it does not assert that every included line was authored from scratch. Dependency notices remain in the repository.
exclusion_note: No foreign projects, dependency trees, build outputs, real .env files, vendored PDF.js module/worker, credentials, or temporary runtime state. Firebase browser configuration is public application configuration, not a service-account credential. Current Firebase application/rules/configuration and tests are printed alongside retained historical implementation source. Inherited UI/hook scaffold, vendored CSS and upstream licenses are supplied as hash-listed exact attachments for complete builds; inclusion does not claim original authorship. Generated model/data/evaluation JSON, sanitized Firebase test reports, the dependency lockfile, selected supporting prose, and binary assets are hash-listed rather than printed. All printed and hash-listed files are embedded in the PDF as byte-exact attachments and included in the companion source ZIP. Inclusion does not assert that inherited runtime helpers were authored from scratch.

pdf.line_number_convention: Original source line; > marks a wrapped continuation.
